task: Decide whether completed runs justify a change to shared agent behavior, and return exactly one decision. First perform the same bounded evidence pass as the reviewer: (1) (runs/list-runs 20 nil), without return; (2) choose a run and call (runs/review-seed run-id), which returns its filtered errors, final exact generated program, and final exact model response through three audited source reads in one evaluation. The compact seed omits the cumulative model-request transcript; call runs/latest-model-exchange only if that transcript is necessary to justify the decision. Do not open unfiltered turn pages or traverse older private pages during this initial pass. If those records show a reusable behavior gap, use runs/effective-preludes and repo/search, repo/find-files, or repo/read-range to read only the component that owns it before proposing a change. Otherwise decide "no-change" or "insufficient-evidence" without spending the remaining turns on speculative browsing. Treat every runs/* or repo/* result as an intermediate observation and never return it directly; use return only for the final schema-shaped decision. Return a map, never a bare decision string: its "decision" key carries one of "propose-change", "no-change", or "insufficient-evidence", and the remaining keys depend on which one. {"decision" "propose-change", "target" ..., "generalized_failure" ..., "evidence" [...], "candidate" {"format" "component-source", "component_id" ..., "base_source_hash" ..., "content" ...}, "evaluation_plan" {"motivating_cases" [...], "regression_cases" [...], "metrics" [...]}} applies only when the evidence shows a reusable gap that would recur on inputs unlike the ones examined; its generalized_failure must be independent of any single run. Copy candidate.base_source_hash exactly from the matching item's sha256-prefixed source_hash returned by runs/effective-preludes. Return complete replacement source, not a diff. Do not invent a candidate source hash: trusted host materialization computes SHA-256 from the exact returned content. {"decision" "no-change", "rationale" ..., "evidence" [...]} applies when sufficient evidence shows only an isolated defect. {"decision" "insufficient-evidence", "rationale" ..., "missing_evidence" [...]} applies when the captured providers cannot settle the question; name what must be captured. Build the returned map and every nested map with PTC-Lisp string keys, not keyword keys. Every evidence item has exactly four fields: "provider", "snapshot_hash", "resource", and "positions". Copy provider and snapshot_hash exactly from the runs/* or repo/* response. For history or private-history, resource is the run ID and positions contains positive event sequence IDs. For workspace, resource is the relative path and positions contains the positive source line numbers cited. Do not cite a response that lacks provider or snapshot_hash. Keep reasoning outside evidence: use "generalized_failure" and optional "risks" for a proposal, or "rationale" for the branches that define it. A single failing run is not by itself a reusable gap, and an unsupported proposal fails evaluation even when its patch looks reasonable.
